title: Project configuration (v0 CONFIG-01)
description: Team-owned configuration of a project or one repo override. Live sections (triggers, approvals) are read at use time; pinned sections (gates, risk, workflows) are compiled into a derived Release Bundle at intake and apply to new jobs only. Every section is optional; omitted fields take the effective value of the parent (repo override -> project -> defaults).

min_trigger_role.description: Least role on the project that may start a job (job:create is required too).

readiness_override.description: Accept jobs for repos whose readiness probe is blocked (ONBOARD-01 §4).

approver_groups.description: Empty: anyone holding gate:decide on the project may decide.

slack_channel.description: Slack approval channel id; null uses the tenant's channel.

publish.description: The publish gate cannot be turned off (I-3).

large_change_files.description: More changed files than this is at least medium risk.

sensitive_paths.description: Globs; a change touching one is at least high risk.

forbidden_paths.description: Globs; the verifier fails a change touching one.

repo_config.description: Pinned (new jobs): use the repo's own Claude Code configuration from the base branch (hooks, rules, skills, nested CLAUDE.md) under the platform's managed settings, or ignore it (design §8c).

models.description: Pinned (new jobs): model tier per workflow type, from the platform's model_tiers catalogue (ONBOARD-01 §8-9).

graph_yaml.description: Advanced: a whole GraphDefinition (existing node types only).
